findings.evidence: Part 588 is only an owner-registration recordkeeping duty: 'maintain lists of the names and addresses of child restraint owners' to support recall notification (s588.1, s588.2). UN R44/R129 are product performance approvals; no UN counterpart for recall recordkeeping.

s591.1: 'establishes procedures governing the importation of motor vehicles and motor vehicle equipment' (customs/declaration procedure). UN R116/R162 are anti-theft/immobilizer technical requirements; no UN equivalent for an import declaration procedure.
Summary text is cut off mid-sentence with an ellipsis (same truncation pattern appears in 592, 593, 594, 595, 596, 575.104, 575.105, 575.106, 575.301, 575.302, 575.401, Dodd-Frank and MA records).

Part 595 is a make-inoperative exemption for retrofit air bag on-off switches and disability modifications (s595.2). UN R114 covers replacement airbag modules/steering wheels as equipment approval; it does not correspond to this exemption.

findings.evidence: Part 596 specifies AEB test devices (pedestrian mannequin, vehicle test device, carriers) for NHTSA compliance testing, not vehicle requirements. UN R152 is the AEB vehicle requirement; it is a related subject, not an equivalent of a test-device specification.

findings.proposed: (none / partial: R117 covers rolling resistance, wet grip, noise only)
findings.evidence: 575.104 is a consumer-information grading scheme (treadwear, traction, temperature) label. UN R117 specifies wet grip, rolling resistance and noise limits; treadwear and temperature grading have no UN counterpart.

Body: 'requires manufacturers of utility vehicles to alert the drivers ... higher possibility of rollover' via a sun visor label; it is a rollover warning label, not an airbag item. Airbag only appears as label spacing relative to the s571.208 air bag warning label.

findings.current: in-force (summary: manufactured on or after Sept 1, 2007)
findings.proposed: Note that 575.301 applies only to vehicles not subject to 575.302, i.e. effectively legacy MY2008-2011 vehicles
findings.evidence: s575.301(b): 'manufactured on or after September 1, 2007 ... except for vehicles that are subject to s575.302' and title '(applicable unless a vehicle is subject to s575.302)'. 575.302 applies to MY2012+ built on/after Jan 31, 2012, so for current production 575.301 is superseded; summary does not say so.
575.401 is a point-of-sale fuel economy and environment label. UN R101 (CO2/fuel consumption measurement) and R154 (WLTP emissions) are test/type approval requirements, not labelling.

UN R155/R156 are cybersecurity/software-update type approval; not equivalent. Closest conceptual relation is RMI under Reg (EU) 2018/858, as the body's own Related Regulations says.
